about: Five paired 28-day supplies of OxyContin 40 mg twice daily and Prodeine Forte 500 mg/30 mg once daily give 120 mg plus 3.9 mg of oral morphine equivalent each day for 140 days.
The pharmacist gives chronic non-cancer pain as the reason for the morphine course, and the six 28-day supplies cover more than three months at 200 mg daily.
OxyContin 40 mg twice daily for over three months gives exactly 120 mg oral morphine equivalent per day and does not exceed the threshold.
